text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a spike of 503s on embeddings in eu-west1 since 08:14 UTC. Root cause looks like TTL config got set to 0 from the staging sync. Rolling back to image v2.3.1 mitigates. Need an expedited hotfix for prod. Can we skip canary and pin the image?
jen: Ack. I can run the rollout and smoke quickly.
kevin: Oncall? @ops_oncall please weigh in, this is ~2% of requests failing for some customers.
ops_oncall: I see the alerts, investigating traces now. If rollback fixes it I'm ok with skipping canary but need monitoring & a rollback plan.
alex: @ops_oncall noted. releasebot: deploy-checklist required: 2 infra approvals + oncall ack. Current change window: open.
jen: I give infra +1. ran the smoke locally against v2.3.1 and KV cache behaves.
kevin: security +1, no suspicious changes in config diff.
releasebot: deploy request queued: image=redwood/serving:v2.3.1-hotfix-ttl-613210; canary=false; pinned=true; requested_by=alex. Preconditions: smoke-tests=pass, infra-approvals=2, oncall=ack.
ops_oncall: ack; I'll watch P99 latency, error-rate, and embeddings 5xx. Rolling out 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 3m pauses. Alert if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.
maria: drafting release note: "Hotfix: embeddings 503s in EU due to TTL regression introduced by config sync. Rolled back to v2.3.1. No customer data exposed. Monitoring in progress." Thoughts?
alex: that wording is good. add the rollback command snippet so SREs can act fast if needed: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/serving --to-image=redwood/serving:stable-v2.3.0`
jen: thumbs up on note, will post to release channel once rollout completes.
releasebot: preflight checks passed: e2e-smoke=ok, canary-skip-flag validated, kv-cache warm. Starting rollout at 08:29 UTC.
ops_oncall: 10% -> 50% progress: metrics look good so far, 5xx at 0.02%. Continuing.
alex: thanks all. tagging docs team to update release notes: @maria for final publish.
maria: published to release-notes/internal and added monitoring tags.
ops_oncall: rollout to 100% complete at 08:39 UTC. No regressions observed. I'll keep a close eye for next 30m.
kevin: great, marking security review complete.
jen: closing tix and attaching short postmortem stub to the changelog.
alex: moving this thread to resolved once postmortem/notes are in. Thanks everyone :pray:
